Here are the five news items investors should watch:

Goldman sees $1.4T in AI spending:

Goldman Sachs expects U.S. hyperscalers to deploy $1.4 trillion in capital in 2027 as artificial intelligence shifts from experimentation toward implementation. The estimate is above Wall Street consensus, with computing demand still
supply and much of the infrastructure under development already contracted.
Trump asks for a new AI name:

President Donald Trump is asking his Truth Social followers to choose a more "elegant and accurate" name for machine intelligence. His proposed options include Superior Intelligence, Extreme Intelligence and Supreme Intelligence, while he again described concerns about AI threatening humanity as a "hoax."
Tanker shortage puts pressure on fuel prices:

A shortage of oil supertankers is pushing shipping rates to record levels and adding pressure to gasoline prices. Attacks on Saudi Arabia's bypass pipeline have forced more crude through the Strait of Hormuz, while Windward said the cost of hiring a supertanker in the Persian Gulf exceeded $1 million a day earlier this month.
